From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>

Subject: GCP listing intake -> purchase playbook kickoff & roles

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the interest in listing Sigma Analytics on GCP Marketplace and for the quick intro call earlier. I wanted to kick off a short intake and procurement playbook so we have clear owners, a target timeline, and the docs we'll need from your side. High-level goal: get the listing submitted to GCP, mapping SKUs and entitlements, and complete purchase onboarding so your customers can buy via the marketplace by mid-July.

Proposed 3-week cadence:
- Week 1 (this week): intake items + contract loop (SOW/PO/partner terms)
- Week 2: SKU & entitlement mapping + billing wiring
- Week 3: GCP seller form + marketplace submit + final QA

Owners (suggested):
- Redwood lead / intake & timeline: me (Neha)
- Technical & SKU mapping: Karthik
- Billing / commercial signoff & DocuSign: Marissa
- Ops escalation & preflight: Vanessa

Action items for Sigma (please confirm by EOD):
1) Share final SOW or PO template (we received a draft in the call — attach here if helpful).
2) Provide primary procurement contact (name + email).
3) Any reseller/partner resell constraints we should know about.

I attached a blank procure checklist workbook and a sample SKU mapping file to speed things up.

If that cadence works we'll schedule two 30-min alignment calls (this week and next) and loop in GCP Marketplace Ops when we hit the seller form step.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

Thanks Sara — this helps. Short answers:
- Either is fine to start intake; a PO gets things moving faster for billing but a signed SOW + PO is cleaner for commercial terms. We'll accept the PO to start SKU mapping and seller form prep.
- For naming: prefix with your company shortname (SIGMA) then the offering and plan (e.g., SIGMA-ANALYTICS-SaaS-MANAGED). We'll provide a sample mapping in the template we sent.

Next steps: I'll schedule a 30-min alignment tomorrow at 10am PT to walk the attached checklist and confirm the PO path. Karthik will cover SKU mapping on the call. Vanessa will cover ops preflight and required telemetry for the listing.

I'll also attach the SFDC/HubSpot deal ID to the checklist and drop a placeholder DocuSign link once Marissa confirms the commercial terms.

Best,
Neha

Thanks all — filling in technical/billing step details so we have a single source of truth:

Procurement & SKU mapping checklist (draft):
1) Receive PO or signed SOW (Sigma) — link PO number to HubSpot deal.
2) Confirm legal entity and tax ID for invoicing (Sigma legal).
3) Create SKU mapping in our template (attached) — include billing metric (monthly seats / subscription / usage), unit price, and entitlement metadata.
4) Confirm reseller or standing reseller agreement (if Sigma will allow resellers on the marketplace).
5) Submit GCP seller form (we will complete most fields but need Sigma's legal & primary contact info).
6) GCP review — typically 3-7 business days; Ops may request additional telemetry or a simple trial flow for validation.
7) Finalize DocuSign for commercial terms and submit for signature.

Notes: I added a few columns in gcp-procure-checklist-v1.xlsx for mapping entitlement IDs to SKU codes — this prevents last-minute mismatches. Marissa, can you confirm the DocuSign template (commercial + payment terms) we should use and whether we need a separate invoice schedule for marketplace purchases?

For call tomorrow: Karthik will walk sample SKU names and mapping; we can finalize naming convention and export the mapping to CSV for GCP submit.

-Karthik
Staff Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference
